observations: A dark figure bends forward at the waist, head down, with a small yellow X mark at the neck; wavy radiating lines spread outward from the head in all directions against a flat pink field.
Two squat rectangular forms sit beneath the figure, each bearing a starburst mark drawn in black line; a horizontal shadow line runs beneath them.
A small spiral snail shape sits in the lower left corner, isolated and low to the ground, while the artist's signature mark appears in the lower right.
reading: The figure's bowed posture and the lines fanning from its head read as strain rather than triumph. The yellow X at the neck is the only color accent—small but insistent against the open pink field. Below, two boxy forms with matching starburst marks anchor the composition. The snail in the far corner introduces a second scale and a quieter pace, pulling against the radiating tension above.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work contrasts sharply with its immediate neighbors: nnxyz nnotb #125 fills the frame with dense layered color, and nnxyz nnotb #127 is an all-over abstract in orange. Here, open pink space and a single isolated figure replace both approaches.

connections.reason: Both works use a pink background and place a yellow X mark as the sole color accent within otherwise black line drawing, making the X a recurring visual signal across the owned collection.
